verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce lets users define mandate-based rules (decline thresholds, effective-until times, consumer prompts) that automatically trigger authorization/decline actions, and documents that payment confirmation can 'trigger post-purchase actions in real-time' — a narrow but real form of event-triggered automation scoped to payments. However this is limited to spend-limit/mandate conditions rather than general-purpose 'if event X then action Y' rule definition across arbitrary triggers. Missing for 10: evidence of a general rules engine or broader event catalogue beyond payment thresholds, and independent/hands-on confirmation that post-purchase action triggers work as described.
